record.edic_text:
2510 kathapto {kath-ap'-to}

from 2596 and 680;; v

AV - fasten on 1; 1

1) to fit or fasten to, bind on
2) to lay hold of, fasten on (hostilely)

same.cexp: 點燃生火；＜關＞拉住，摸；傷害
